directions: Suppose the university newspaper is inviting submissions from the students for its coining edition on what in their university impresses them most. You are now to write an essay for submission. You will have 30 minutes to write the essay. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
When reflecting on my university life, several aspects stand out as truly impressive. To begin with, the academic environment here is highly stimulating. Professors are not only knowledgeable but also passionate about teaching. For example, in my literature class, the professor's in-depth analysis of classic works opened up a whole new world for me, which greatly enhanced my understanding and appreciation of literature.

In addition, the campus facilities are top-notch. The well-equipped library provides a vast collection of books and online resources, allowing students to conduct comprehensive research. The modern sports facilities, such as the gym and the swimming pool, encourage students to maintain a healthy lifestyle.

Furthermore, the rich variety of student clubs and activities is another highlight. Whether it's the debate club, the music club, or the volunteer organization, there is always something for everyone. These clubs offer opportunities for students to develop their interests and skills outside of the classroom.

In conclusion, the academic environment, campus facilities, and student activities in my university have left a deep impression on me. They have not only contributed to my personal growth but also made my university life fulfilling and memorable.
